const question = $json.question || "";

const query = `
MATCH (n)
WHERE 
  n:TestReport
  OR n:AuditFinding
  OR n:IncidentReport
  OR n:MaintenanceEvent
  OR any(k IN keys(n) WHERE
    toLower(k) CONTAINS "quality"
    OR toLower(k) CONTAINS "test"
    OR toLower(k) CONTAINS "defect"
    OR toLower(k) CONTAINS "failure"
    OR toLower(k) CONTAINS "inspection"
    OR toLower(k) CONTAINS "audit"
    OR toLower(k) CONTAINS "result"
  )
OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[r]-(connected)
RETURN
  coalesce(
    n.test_report_id,
    n.audit_id,
    n.incident_id,
    n.maintenance_id,
    n.id
  ) AS item_id,
  labels(n)[0] AS item_type,
  coalesce(
    n.name,
    n.description,
    n.finding,
    n.status,
    n.result,
    n.event_type,
    n.incident_description,
    n.id
  ) AS item_name,
  properties(n) AS properties,
  type(r) AS relationship,
  labels(connected) AS connected_labels,
  coalesce(
    connected.actor_name,
    connected.name,
    connected.unit_id,
    connected.process_id,
    connected.process_name,
    connected.material_name,
    connected.location_name,
    connected.id
  ) AS connected_entity
LIMIT 100
`;

return [
  {
    json: {
      agent: "quality_analyst",
      domain: "Quality Analyst",
      question,
      query,
      params: {},
    },
  },
];
